candidate: finite-time survivor transport, possible same-family revision
apparatus: Replace asymptotic conditional drift by finite-time mean displacement of a uniform injected pulse conditioned on no Robin capture by the final observation time.
source: Integrate the exact instantaneous endpoint-survivor velocity mean over time. This is a complete evolving-endpoint closure, which conditions each sampled time on survival only to that time.
physical: At intermediate s, use forward radial density at s times backward survival to t, normalized by survival to t. Equivalently propagate zeroth and first axial moments.
calibration: Retain exact positive-capture loss-rate calibration for global D identifiability; add finite-time survival and uniform-flow/reflecting displacement preparations.

preliminary_check.method: 128-cell radial generator and 96-point time quadrature for source; existing moment propagator for conditional mean. This is a small internal comparison, not an independent new validation.

decision: Defer behind genuinely different waving-sheet and collisionless-screening candidates. Finite-time conditioning is substantively different from the stationary readout, but shares the r1 physical selection error and may add numerical burden more than difficulty. No new model run or frozen task.
development_timing: After survivor r1 completed2/3passes; does not replace, resample or reinterpret its outcomes.
